fact: BCEAO lists Mali's 12 institutions authorised to open PI-SPI services to the public, an interoperable instant payment platform it runs, as updated 2 April 2026.
Mali has 12 institutions authorised by BCEAO to open PI-SPI, the UEMOA regional instant payment platform, to the public as of 2 April 2026.
The World Bank says Mali's connection to the regional switch is inefficient, which limits public and private users of the payment system, while the Public Treasury is not yet connected to GIM-UEMOA.
Bénin Web TV reports, from the BCEAO list, that Mali has two licensed payment institutions at 31 August 2026.
BCEAO runs PI-SPI, the instant payment platform for UEMOA members including Mali, launched 30 September 2025 with 175 connected participants a year later.
Mali is a UEMOA member in the BCEAO's PI-SPI regional instant payment system, in service.
The BCEAO list says the BCEAO builds and runs PI-SPI, an instant payment switch serving Mali.
The BCEAO list places Mali in the eight-country WAEMU PI-SPI rail run by the BCEAO.
The TerraPay press release says Orange Finances Money Mali is an e-money institution licensed by the Central Bank of West African States (BCEAO), founded in 2015.
